filename: Structured dataset of reported cloud seeding activities in the United States (2000–2025) using an LLM.pdf
title: Structured dataset of reported cloud seeding activities in the United States (2000–2025) using an LLM
code_availability: Python code for extracting the dataset from the NOAA reports can be obtained from our public GitHub repository (https://github.com/jdonohue44/NOAA-Weather-Modification-Forms-LLM-Extractor). Python code for visualizing the dataset is also publicly available on GitHub (https://github.com/jdonohue44/US-Cloud-Seeding-Analysis).
testbed_rationale: The dataset provides historical regulatory/administrative activity records (project dates, locations, agents, purpose) rather than physical or meteorological state variables used for parameterization or emulation.
pain_points: Scanned historical documents with inconsistent structure, low-resolution scans, and handwritten text
Unstandardized reporting forms referring to external attachments or previous years' reports leaving form fields blank
Risk of LLM hallucination on numerical dates, locations, and descriptions requiring chain-of-thought prompt engineering and human validation
API costs and daily rate limits associated with OCR and LLM services
extraction_notes: The ML application in this paper is LLM-based structured information extraction (NLP/document parsing) rather than physics parameterization or climate modeling.
